rules.question: What happens when a user attempts to send a channel message to “general chat” while topics are required?
rules.rule: When administrators require topics in channel messages, users cannot send channel messages to the “general chat” topic.

rules.question: What happens when a user visits the Direct URL after closing their document fork?
rules.rule: After a user closes their document fork, visiting the document's Direct URL automatically redirects them to their saved fork.

rules.question: How does joining a user group through its plus icon behave for users with different permissions?
rules.rule: A user may join a user group using its plus icon only if they have permission to join it.

rules.question: What suggestions appear when you type a user's name in the search box?
rules.rule: Typing a user's name in the search box offers a suggestion for direct messages with that user.

rules.question: What happens when a non-admin user tries to unsubscribe themselves from a channel?
rules.rule: Any user can unsubscribe themselves from a channel they belong to.

rules.question: How does an administrator's subscription status affect adding users to a private channel?
rules.rule: A user with permission to administer a private channel must also subscribe to that channel before they can subscribe other users to it.

rules.question: How does an emoji released after 2017 appear when Google blobs is selected?
rules.rule: When Google blobs is selected, emoji released after 2017 must display in the modern Google style.

rules.question: What does a user see when opening a document with suggestions enabled, and does sign-in status affect the result?
rules.rule: When suggestions are enabled, opening a document automatically opens a copy for both signed-in and signed-out users.

rules.question: How does selecting 'Set default: Collapse' affect the page list when the document is reopened?
rules.rule: After a user selects 'Set default: Collapse' for a parent page, its nested pages must be collapsed when the document is reopened.

rules.question: What appears when you press Shift+F10 in the grid?
rules.rule: Pressing Shift+F10 in the grid opens the context menu.

rules.question: What happens when a user tries to enable On-Demand Tables in a new document?
rules.rule: Users cannot enable On-Demand Tables in new Grist documents.

rules.question: What happens when a user tries to assign another billing manager to a team that already has 10?
rules.rule: A team may have at most 10 billing managers.

rules.question: Which users appear in the subscription typeahead when matching users have different subscription statuses?
rules.rule: The user subscription typeahead must exclude users already subscribed to the target channel.

rules.question: How does permission to edit a message affect the controls shown for it?
rules.rule: A message the user has permission to edit must display the pencil edit icon.

rules.question: What happens when an administrator tries to make a private channel a default channel for new users?
rules.rule: Only public or web-public channels can be selected as default channels for new users.

rules.question: How does the email address generation button appear for users with different channel messaging permissions?
rules.rule: The button to generate a channel email address must be hidden when the user lacks permission to send messages to that channel.

rules.question: What control does the user have over the read status of automated notices?
rules.rule: Users can configure whether automated notices are automatically marked as read.

rules.question: What happens in the left sidebar when you enable the channel’s pin toggle in Personal settings?
rules.rule: Enabling “Pin channel to top of left sidebar” in a channel’s Personal settings places that channel at the top of the left sidebar.

rules.question: Which initial settings does an invited user receive if the defaults change between invitation and acceptance?
rules.rule: When a user accepts an invitation, their initial settings must match the defaults configured at acceptance time.

rules.question: Which permissions can a user select when editing a table-level access rule?
rules.rule: Structure (S) permissions must not be available in table-level access rules.

rules.question: What appears in the compose box after changing the GIF picker setting to Disabled?
rules.rule: Setting GIF picker to Disabled in Compose settings removes the GIF picker from the compose box.

rules.question: What controls are available for managing deletion of a user's own messages in a channel?
rules.rule: A channel's Moderation permissions must allow users to configure who can delete their own messages in that channel.

rules.question: What happens when you click Restart in the tutorial popup while you have unsaved edits?
rules.rule: Clicking Restart at the bottom of the tutorial popup refreshes the page and discards unsaved changes.

rules.question: What appears in the compose box after pasting a URL matching a reverse-enabled linkifier?
rules.rule: When a user pastes a URL matching a reverse-enabled linkifier into the compose box, it automatically becomes linked text corresponding to that linkifier.

rules.question: What messages appear when you search for channels:archived?
rules.rule: Searching for channels:archived returns only messages the user received in archived channels.

rules.question: How does conditional formatting configured under 'Row Style' appear in a matching row?
rules.rule: Conditional formatting added under 'Row Style' must apply across the entire matching table row.

rules.question: Who can see conversations in a private channel?
rules.rule: Conversations in a private channel are visible to users who have been granted access to that channel.

rules.question: What happens when you upload an attachment to a document whose storage is nearly full?
rules.rule: On every plan, a document's combined attachment and data storage must not exceed 1GB.

rules.question: Where on the channel settings screen can you find "Who can subscribe anyone to this channel"?
rules.rule: The channel settings screen must place the "Who can subscribe anyone to this channel" setting under "Advanced configurations".

rules.question: How does a screen reader announce Markdown content written as '# Content title'?
rules.rule: A screen reader must announce Markdown content beginning with '# ' as a heading rather than reading the hash symbol aloud.

judge_controls.answer: When you close a task, any subtasks that were still open or in progress are set to done.
judge_controls.rule: Closing a task marks all of its unfinished subtasks as done.

judge_controls.answer: Duplicate foods are merged into one line and their quantities added, so 1 and 2 cups become 3 cups.
judge_controls.rule: A shopping list combines items with the same food: 1 cup plus 2 cups of cheese shows 3 cups.

judge_controls.answer: Closing a task hides it from the board; its subtasks keep whatever status they had.
judge_controls.rule: Closing a task marks all of its unfinished subtasks as done.

judge_controls.answer: I am not sure how templates work in this application.
judge_controls.rule: Only administrators can set a project as a template.
